title: Reservar un vuelo
description: Necesitas volar a otra ciudad urgentemente.
objective: Reserva un vuelo a Madrid para el 15 de marzo. Menciona que viajas solo y necesitas asiento de ventana.
scene_context: Estás llamando a una aerolinea internacional. Tienes que interactuar con el agente en Inglés. Tienes que completar 3 pasos: 1. Confirmar destino y fecha (Madrid, 15 Mar). 2. Confirmar pasajero (solo). 3. Seleccionar asiento (Ventana).
expected_outcome_indicator: Flight booked for March 15th
example_conversation:
User: Hi, I'd like to book a flight to Madrid for March 15th.
Agent: Sure, I can help with that. Are you traveling alone?
User: Yes, just me.
Agent: Great. Do you have a seating preference?
User: I'd prefer a window seat, please.

title: Problema técnico al soporte
description: Tu computador tiene un error crítico.
objective: Explica al agente de soporte que tu computador no enciende desde esta mañana y que escuchas un sonido extraño al encenderlo.
scene_context: Llamas al soporte técnico de tu empresa. El agente contesta y pide que describas el problema.
expected_outcome_indicator: Support ticket opened with correct details
example_conversation:
User: Hello, I'm calling because my computer won't turn on.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Did anything happen before this?
User: It was working fine yesterday, but this morning I heard a strange noise and it won't start.
Agent: Okay, let's try some troubleshooting steps.

title: Pedir direcciones
description: Estás perdido en una ciudad desconocida.
objective: Pregunta a un transeúnte cómo llegar al Museo de Historia. Menciona que vas caminando.
scene_context: Estás en una calle del centro de la ciudad. Ves a una persona local que parece poder ayudarte.
expected_outcome_indicator: Directions received clearly
example_conversation:
User: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the History Museum?
Local: Sure! It's not far. Are you driving or walking?
User: I'm walking.
Local: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. It's on your right.

title: Negociar un precio
description: Quieres comprar un artículo pero el precio es alto.
objective: Negocia el precio de una mochila. El precio inicial es $80. Intenta conseguirlo por menos de $65, justificando tu oferta.
scene_context: Estás en un mercado artesanal. El vendedor tiene mochilas de cuero. Ves una que te gusta.
expected_outcome_indicator: Price negotiated below $65
example_conversation:
User: I love this backpack, but $80 is a bit out of my budget.
Vendor: It's good quality leather. How much were you thinking?
User: Could you do $60? I'm buying it as a gift.
Vendor: I can't go that low, but I could do $70.
User: How about $65? That matches the cash I have.

title: Llamar al médico
description: No te sientes bien y necesitas una cita.
objective: Llama al consultorio médico y agenda una cita para mañana. Menciona que tienes fiebre y dolor de garganta.
scene_context: Llamas al consultorio del Dr. Rivera. La recepcionista contesta y pregunta en qué puede ayudarte.
expected_outcome_indicator: Doctor appointment confirmed for tomorrow
example_conversation:
Receptionist: Dr. Rivera's office, how can I help you?
User: Hi, I need to make an appointment for tomorrow, please.
Receptionist: Is it for a check-up or are you feeling ill?
User: I'm not feeling well. I have a fever and a sore throat.
Receptionist: Okay, we can squeeze you in at 10 AM.

title: Check-in en el hotel
description: Llegas al hotel pero hay un problema con tu reserva.
objective: Explica al recepcionista que tienes una reserva para esta noche pero que no aparece en el sistema. Tu confirmación es #45823.
scene_context: Llegas al Hotel Plaza después de un largo viaje. El recepcionista te saluda y pide tu nombre.
expected_outcome_indicator: Reservation issue resolved
example_conversation:
Receptionist: Good afternoon, welcome to Hotel Plaza. Do you have a reservation?
User: Yes, I booked a room for tonight, but I don't see it on my app.
Receptionist: Let me check. Do you have the confirmation number?
User: Yes, it's #45823. I booked it last week.
Receptionist: Ah, found it. There was a typo in the name. You're all set.

title: Ordenar en un restaurante
description: Tienes una alergia alimentaria importante.
objective: Ordena el plato del día pero pregunta si contiene nueces porque eres alérgico. Si tiene nueces, pide una alternativa.
scene_context: Estás en un restaurante casual. El mesero se acerca con la carta y te pregunta qué vas a ordenar.
expected_outcome_indicator: Order placed with allergy confirmed
example_conversation:
Waiter: Are you ready to order?
User: Yes, I'd like the daily special, please.
Waiter: Excellent choice.
User: Does it contain any nuts? I have a severe allergy.
Waiter: The sauce has crushed walnuts. I can have the chef prepare it without the sauce for you.

title: Presentarse en trabajo nuevo
description: Es tu primer día en una empresa nueva.
objective: Preséntate a tu nuevo colega. Di tu nombre, tu cargo (Marketing Manager), y menciona algo de tu experiencia anterior.
scene_context: Entras a la oficina el primer día. Tu colega se acerca sonriendo y se presenta. Te toca responder.
expected_outcome_indicator: Professional introduction completed
example_conversation:
Colleague: Hi, welcome to the team! I'm Sarah.
User: Hi Sarah, nice to meet you. I'm Alex.
Colleague: What will you be working on?
User: I'm the new Marketing Manager. I used to work in digital advertising for 5 years.

title: Reclamar un paquete perdido
description: Tu pedido online nunca llegó.
objective: Reclama a la empresa de envíos que tu paquete con número de seguimiento TK-2847 no llegó en la fecha prometida. Pide solución.
scene_context: Llamas al servicio al cliente de la empresa de envíos. Llevas 5 días esperando el paquete.
expected_outcome_indicator: Claim registered with tracking number
example_conversation:
Agent: Customer service, how can I help?
User: Hi, I'm calling about a missing package. Tracking number TK-2847.
Agent: Let me check. It says it was delivered yesterday.
User: I've been home all day and nothing arrived. I need a solution or a refund.

title: Pedir ayuda en una tienda
description: Buscas un producto específico.
objective: Pide ayuda para encontrar vitamina C en presentación de 1000mg. Pregunta también si tienen una marca específica.
scene_context: Estás en una farmacia grande. No encuentras lo que buscas y un empleado se acerca para ayudarte.
expected_outcome_indicator: Product found or alternative offered
example_conversation:
Employee: Can I help you find something?
User: Yes, do you have Vitamin C in 1000mg tablets?
Employee: We have the store brand right here.
User: Do you carry the 'NatureHealth' brand specifically?

title: Reportar un problema de vecindad
description: Hay ruido excesivo en tu edificio.
objective: Reporta al administrador del edificio que el apartamento 4B tiene música muy alta desde las 11pm todos los días. Pide que intervengan.
scene_context: Llamas a la oficina de administración del edificio. El administrador contesta.
expected_outcome_indicator: Complaint registered with details
example_conversation:
User: Hello, I'm calling to report a noise problem.
Manager: Okay, what seems to be the issue?
User: Apartment 4B has been playing very loud music every night since 11 PM.
Manager: I see. Have you spoken to them?
User: No, I'd like you to intervene, please.

title: Cancelar una suscripción
description: Quieres cancelar un servicio que no usas.
objective: Cancela tu suscripción al gimnasio. Llevas 6 meses pagando sin ir. Pide que el cargo no se haga el próximo mes.
scene_context: Llamas al servicio al cliente del gimnasio. Te contesta un representante.
expected_outcome_indicator: Subscription cancellation confirmed
example_conversation:
Agent: Gym membership services, how can I help?
User: Hi, I'd like to cancel my subscription.
Agent: May I ask why you're leaving?
User: I haven't used it in 6 months. Please ensure no charge is made next month.
Agent: I can process that for you.

title: Pedir información de un curso
description: Quieres inscribirte en un curso de idiomas.
objective: Pregunta cuánto cuesta el curso de inglés avanzado, cuándo empieza el próximo grupo y si hay descuento por pagar completo.
scene_context: Llamas a un instituto de idiomas. La secretaria contesta con un saludo y ofrece su ayuda.
expected_outcome_indicator: Price, start date, and discount info obtained
example_conversation:
Secretary: Hello, Language Institute.
User: Hi, I'd like information about the advanced English course.
Secretary: Certainly. What would you like to know?
User: How much does it cost and when does the next group start?
Secretary: It's $200 and starts next Monday.
User: Is there a discount for paying in full?

title: Describir un accidente menor
description: Tuviste un pequeño accidente de tráfico.
objective: Explica a la policía lo que pasó: otro carro te golpeó por detrás mientras esperabas en un semáforo. No hay heridos.
scene_context: Un oficial de policía se acerca al lugar del accidente y pide tu declaración de lo sucedido.
expected_outcome_indicator: Accident description given with key details
example_conversation:
Officer: Can you tell me what happened here?
User: Yes, officer. I was waiting at the red light.
Officer: And then?
User: Another car hit me from behind. There are no injuries, just damage to the bumper.

title: Saludar y presentarse
description: Tu primera conversación en inglés.
objective: Preséntate: di tu nombre, de dónde eres y algo que te guste. Hazle una pregunta a la otra persona.
scene_context: Estás en un evento de networking. Una persona amable se acerca y te saluda con un 'Hi there!'.
expected_outcome_indicator: Introduction with name, origin, and interest completed
example_conversation:
Person: Hi there!
User: Hello! My name is Ana. I'm from Colombia.
Person: Nice to meet you, Ana.
User: I enjoy hiking on weekends. What about you?
Person: I love reading.

title: Conocer a alguien en una fiesta
description: Estás en una fiesta y no conoces a nadie.
objective: Preséntate a la persona que está junto a las bebidas. Pregúntale su nombre y de dónde conoce al anfitrión (Juan).
scene_context: Estás en la sala de una casa con música de fondo y gente charlando. Te acercas a alguien que parece amigable.
expected_outcome_indicator: Introduction made and connection to host established
example_conversation:
User: Hi, do you mind if I join you?
Guest: Not at all! I'm Tom.
User: Nice to meet you, Tom. I'm Leo. How do you know Juan?
Guest: We work together. And you?
User: We're old friends from college.

title: Hablar de planes de fin de semana
description: Es viernes y quieres hacer planes con un amigo.
objective: Invita a tu amigo a ir al cine el sábado. Propón ver la nueva película de acción a las 7 PM.
scene_context: Estás charlando con un amigo en la cafetería. Él te pregunta qué harás el fin de semana.
expected_outcome_indicator: Movie plan proposed for Saturday evening
example_conversation:
Friend: Hey, any plans for the weekend?
User: I was thinking of going to the movies on Saturday. Want to come?
Friend: Sounds fun. What time?
User: The new action movie is playing at 7 PM.

title: Conversación casual en una boda
description: Estás sentado en una mesa con desconocidos.
objective: Inicia una conversación con la persona a tu lado. Pregunta cómo conoce a los novios y comenta qué te parece la ceremonia.
scene_context: Estás en la recepción de una boda elegante. La cena aún no empieza y hay un silencio incómodo en la mesa.
expected_outcome_indicator: Conversation started about the couple and ceremony
example_conversation:
User: It's a beautiful ceremony, isn't it?
Guest: Yes, absolutely lovely. Are you a friend of the bride or groom?
User: I'm a friend of the groom from high school. And you?

title: Debatir sobre una película
description: Acabas de ver una película con un amigo y tienen opiniones diferentes.
objective: Expresa tu opinión de que el final de la película fue decepcionante porque no tuvo sentido, aunque los efectos especiales fueron buenos.
scene_context: Están saliendo del cine. Tu amigo dice que le encantó la película y te pregunta qué piensas tú.
expected_outcome_indicator: Opinion expressed with pros and cons
example_conversation:
Friend: That was amazing! The best movie I've seen all year. What did you think?
User: To be honest, I was a bit disappointed.
Friend: Really? Why?
User: The special effects were great, but the ending didn't make any sense to me.

title: Recomendar un restaurante
description: Un colega visita tu ciudad y busca dónde cenar.
objective: Recomienda tu restaurante italiano favorito. Describe por qué es bueno (la comida, el ambiente) y explica cómo llegar desde la oficina.
scene_context: Estás en el descanso del café con un colega de otra sucursal. Él menciona que quiere probar comida local esta noche.
expected_outcome_indicator: Restaurant recommendation given with reasons and directions
example_conversation:
Colleague: I'm looking for a good place for dinner tonight. Do you know any local spots?
User: You have to try 'La Trattoria'. It's my favorite Italian place.
Colleague: Oh, that sounds good. Why do you like it?
User: The pasta is handmade and the atmosphere is very cozy. plus, it's just two blocks from here.

title: Preguntar la hora a un desconocido
description: Necesitas saber qué hora es porque se te olvidó el reloj.
objective: Preguntarle a una persona en la calle qué hora es, esperar la respuesta y decir 'gracias'.
scene_context: Estás en una parada de autobús esperando. Hablas con una persona desconocida que está también esperando.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student asks for the time and thanks the person
example_conversation:
Person: Hello there!
User: Hi, excuse me. What time is it?
Person: It's 2 o'clock.
User: Thank you!
Person: You're welcome.

title: Reservar una mesa en un restaurante
description: Quieres comer con tu familia en un restaurante este fin de semana.
objective: Reservar una mesa para 4 personas el sábado a las 19:00 horas a nombre de García.
scene_context: Estás hablando por teléfono con el recepcionista del restaurante 'La Marisquería'.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student books a table for 4 people on Saturday at 7pm under the name García
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon, La Marisquería restaurant. How can I help you?
User: Hello, I want to book a table for four people, please.
Person: Yes, certainly. What day?
User: Saturday at 7 o'clock.
Person: What name is the reservation under?
User: García.

title: Pedir ayuda sobre un dolor en la farmacia
description: No te sientes bien y necesitas hablar con el farmacéutico.
objective: Explicar que tienes dolor de cabeza, preguntar qué medicamento recomienda y el precio de la aspirina.
scene_context: Estás en la farmacia local hablando con el farmacéutico detrás del mostrador.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student describes headache, asks for medicine recommendation and price
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning. Can I help you?
User: I have a headache. Do you have aspirin?
Person: Yes, we do. This one is very good.
User: How much is it?
Person: It's 5 euros.
User: Thank you very much.

title: Comprar un billete de autobús
description: Necesitas comprar un billete para viajar en autobús a una ciudad cercana.
objective: Comprar un billete de autobús a Barcelona para el lunes a las 14:00 horas, y preguntar el precio (aproximadamente 12 euros).
scene_context: Estás en la estación de autobuses. Hablas con el vendedor en la ventanilla.
expected_outcome_indicator: Purchases a bus ticket to Barcelona on Monday at 2 PM and confirms the price.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Where would you like to go?
User: I want a ticket to Barcelona, please.
Person: When do you want to travel?
User: Monday at two o'clock.
Person: That is twelve euros.
User: Okay, I take it.

title: Pedir información sobre una casa en alquiler
description: Viste un anuncio de un apartamento y quieres saber más detalles sobre él.
objective: Preguntar al propietario si el apartamento tiene dos dormitorios, baño, y cuál es el precio del alquiler (500 euros al mes).
scene_context: Estás en el apartamento. Hablas con el dueño que quiere alquilarlo.
expected_outcome_indicator: Inquires about the apartment's bedrooms, bathroom, and monthly rent price.
example_conversation:
Person: Welcome! Do you like the apartment?
User: Yes, it is nice. How many bedrooms does it have?
Person: It has two bedrooms and one bathroom.
User: What is the rent per month?
Person: Five hundred euros per month.
User: That is good. Thank you.

title: Ordenar comida en una cafetería
description: El alumno pide un desayuno en una cafetería local.
objective: Pedir un café con leche, dos tostadas y un zumo de naranja. Preguntar el precio total.
scene_context: Estás en una pequeña cafetería por la mañana. Hablas con el camarero detrás del mostrador.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student orders breakfast items and asks for the price
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! What can I have for you?
User: I want a coffee with milk, two toasts and an orange juice, please.
Person: Perfect! That's 8 euros in total.
User: Thank you!

title: Pedir la cuenta en un restaurante
description: El estudiante pide la factura y pregunta el precio total en un restaurante.
objective: Pedir la cuenta a la mesera, preguntar el precio total y mencionar que el total es 25 euros.
scene_context: Estás en un restaurante pequeño. Hablas con la mesera después de terminar de comer.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student asks for the bill and confirms the price.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Did you enjoy your meal?
User: Yes, thank you. Can I have the bill, please?
Person: Of course. That's 25 euros.
User: Okay. Thank you very much!
Person: You're welcome. Have a nice day!

title: Comprar un libro en una librería
description: El estudiante compra un libro específico en una librería y pregunta por el precio.
objective: Entra en una librería, pregunta por el libro 'The Little Prince' y cuánto cuesta (£8.99).
scene_context: Estás en una librería pequeña. Hablas con el dependiente de la tienda.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully finds and prices a book.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Welcome to the bookshop. Can I help you?
User: Hi. Do you have 'The Little Prince'?
Person: Yes, we do. It's on that shelf over there.
User: How much is it?
Person: It's £8.99.
User: Thank you!

title: Preguntar por el horario de cierre de una piscina
description: El estudiante pregunta a qué hora cierra la piscina pública hoy.
objective: Pregunta en la recepción de la piscina a qué hora cierra hoy (cierra a las 18:00).
scene_context: Estás en la recepción de una piscina pública. Hablas con el recepcionista.
expected_outcome_indicator: Obtains the closing time of the facility.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon! How can I help you?
User: What time does the pool close today?
Person: The pool closes at 6 PM.
User: Thank you!
Person: You're welcome. Have a nice day!

title: Pedir información sobre una clase de yoga
description: El estudiante pregunta dónde y cuándo es la próxima clase de yoga.
objective: Pregúntale al instructor dónde es la clase de yoga, qué día es (jueves) y a qué hora (19:00).
scene_context: Estás en un gimnasio. Hablas con el instructor de yoga.
expected_outcome_indicator: Finds out class location, day, and time.
example_conversation:
Person: Hi! Are you interested in our yoga class?
User: Yes. Where is the class?
Person: It's in Studio B, upstairs.
User: What day? What time?
Person: It's on Thursday at 7 PM.
User: Perfect, thank you!

title: Comprar un billete de cine
description: El estudiante compra una entrada de cine para una película específica.
objective: Pide una entrada para 'Frozen 2' hoy a las 16:00 y pregunta el precio (£9.50).
scene_context: Estás en la taquilla de un cine. Hablas con el vendedor de entradas.
expected_outcome_indicator: Purchases a cinema ticket with specific time.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! What can I get for you?
User: One ticket for 'Frozen 2' at 4 PM, please.
Person: That's £9.50.
User: Okay. Here is my money.
Person: Thank you! Enjoy the film!

title: Cambiar un artículo en una tienda
description: Necesitas devolver una camiseta que compraste hace una semana porque la talla no es correcta.
objective: Explica que la camiseta (talla M, €19.99, comprada hace una semana) no te queda bien y pide cambiarla por una talla L.
scene_context: Estás en la tienda de ropa donde compraste la camiseta. Hablas con el vendedor en el mostrador.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully explain the problem and request an exchange for a different size.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning, how can I help you today?
User: Hi, I bought this shirt last week. It is size M but it is too small.
Person: I see, do you want to exchange it? What size do you need?
User: Yes, please. I need a size L. The price was nineteen euros and ninety-nine cents.
Person: No problem, let me check if we have it in stock.
User: Thank you very much. This size fits me much better.

title: Preguntar sobre un servicio en una peluquería
description: Quieres saber el precio y la duración de un corte de cabello antes de hacer una cita.
objective: Pregunta al peluquero el precio del corte (unos €25-30), cuánto dura (unos 30 minutos) y si hay hueco el sábado a las 10:00.
scene_context: Llamas por teléfono o hablas en persona con el peluquero en su negocio.
expected_outcome_indicator: Obtain pricing, duration, and availability information for a haircut appointment.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello, welcome to our salon. What can I do for you?
User: Hi, I want to cut my hair. How much does a haircut cost?
Person: A basic haircut is twenty-five euros. How long is your hair?
User: It is medium length. How long does the haircut take?
Person: It takes about thirty minutes. Do you want to book an appointment?
User: Yes, do you have time next Saturday at ten o'clock?

title: Comprar entradas para un evento
description: Necesitas comprar dos entradas para un concierto que será el próximo mes.
objective: Compra 2 entradas para el concierto de The Singers el 15 de marzo (€35 cada una) y di si prefieres primera o segunda fila.
scene_context: Hablas con el vendedor en la taquilla del teatro o sala de conciertos.
expected_outcome_indicator: Purchase concert tickets with specific date, quantity, and seating preference.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon! What tickets would you like today?
User: I want two tickets for The Singers concert on the fifteenth of March.
Person: Great! That concert is thirty-five euros per ticket. Where would you like to sit?
User: I prefer the first row, please. That is seventy euros in total.
Person: Perfect! Here are your tickets. Enjoy the concert!
User: Thank you very much. What time does it start?

title: Cambiar la hora de una cita médica
description: Tu cita con el doctor es mañana a las 2 de la tarde, pero no puedes asistir a esa hora.
objective: Explica que no puedes ir a la cita del médico de mañana a las 14:00 y pide cambiarla a las 16:00 o a otro día.
scene_context: Llamas a la clínica u oficina del doctor para cambiar tu cita.
expected_outcome_indicator: Reschedule a doctor appointment to a different time.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning, this is the medical clinic. How can I help?
User: Hello, I have an appointment tomorrow at two o'clock, but I cannot come.
Person: I understand. What time would you prefer?
User: Can I come at four o'clock instead? Or maybe another day?
Person: Let me check. Yes, we have four o'clock available tomorrow.
User: That is perfect for me. Thank you very much!

title: Comprar un regalo de cumpleaños
description: Necesitas comprar un regalo en una tienda de ropa para el cumpleaños de tu amiga el próximo sábado.
objective: Pregunta por un suéter azul, su precio (entre 30 y 50 euros) y si hay descuento o envoltorio de regalo. Confirma que te lo llevas.
scene_context: Estás en una tienda de ropa. Un vendedor te ayuda a buscar un regalo.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successful purchase of a gift with price confirmation and delivery/wrapping details.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! What are you looking for today?
User: Hi, I need a blue sweater for my friend's birthday next Saturday.
Person: Great! We have nice blue sweaters. What size does your friend wear?
User: Medium size, please. How much does it cost?
Person: This one is 45 euros. We offer free gift wrapping today.
User: Perfect! I'll take it. Can you wrap it for me?

title: Cambiar dinero en una oficina de cambio
description: Necesitas cambiar 200 libras esterlinas a euros antes de tu viaje a Barcelona.
objective: Di que quieres cambiar 200 libras, pregunta el tipo de cambio, cuántos euros recibirás y la comisión.
scene_context: Te encuentras en una oficina de cambio de divisas en el centro de la ciudad. Un empleado te atiende.
expected_outcome_indicator: Exchange transaction completed with rate and fee details confirmed.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! How can I help you?
User: Hello, I want to exchange 200 British pounds to euros.
Person: Okay, let me check the rate. Today it is 1.17 euros per pound.
User: So how many euros will I get?
Person: You will receive 234 euros. We charge 2 euros commission.
User: That's fine. I need the money today for my trip to Barcelona.

title: Pedir un día libre en el trabajo
description: Necesitas hablar con tu jefe para pedir un día libre el próximo miércoles por una cita importante.
objective: Explica que necesitas libre el miércoles 15 por una cita médica y pregunta si es posible.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina con tu jefe. Es por la mañana y él tiene un momento para hablar contigo.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully requested day off with date and reason provided.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! Do you need something?
User: Yes, I have an important appointment. Can I have Wednesday, March 15 off?
Person: What is the appointment for?
User: It's a medical appointment. I need to go in the morning.
Person: Is it urgent?
User: Yes, it is very important for me. Can you approve it?

title: Alquilar una bicicleta para el fin de semana
description: Necesitas alquilar una bicicleta en una tienda local para pasear el sábado.
objective: Alquila una bicicleta para el sábado, pregunta el precio (15 euros) y confirma que la recoges a las 10:00.
scene_context: Estás en una tienda de alquiler de bicicletas. Hablas con el empleado de la tienda.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully rents a bicycle for Saturday at 10 AM for €15.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Can I help you today?
User: Yes, I want to rent a bicycle for Saturday, please.
Person: Sure! We have many bikes. How long do you need it?
User: Just for one day. What is the price?
Person: It costs fifteen euros per day. What time do you want to pick it up?
User: I can come at ten o'clock in the morning. That's good for me.

title: Comprar un teléfono móvil usado
description: Visitas una tienda de electrónica de segunda mano para comprar un teléfono.
objective: Pregunta el precio del iPhone 12, el año de fabricación, si tiene 6 meses de garantía y cómpralo por 250 euros.
scene_context: Estás en una tienda pequeña de electrónica usada. Hablas con el vendedor sobre un teléfono que está en el escaparate.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student successfully negotiates phone purchase with price, warranty details.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Can I help you today?
User: Yes, how much is this iPhone 12 in the window?
Person: It costs 280 euros. It's in very good condition.
User: Does it have a warranty? I want six months warranty.
Person: We offer six months warranty on all used phones. I can give you 250 euros today.
User: Perfect! I'll take it. Can you wrap it for me?

title: Reservar una clase de arte en un centro comunitario
description: Llamas a un centro comunitario para inscribirte en una clase de pintura.
objective: Pregunta por la clase de pintura de los martes a las 19:00, el precio (45 euros al mes) y si incluye materiales; reserva tu sitio.
scene_context: Estás llamando por teléfono al centro comunitario. Hablas con la recepcionista sobre las clases disponibles.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student books art class with correct day, time, and price confirmed.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon! Community Centre. How can I help?
User: Hi. Do you have painting classes on Tuesdays?
Person: Yes, we have a class at 7 PM. Are you interested?
User: Yes! What is the price per month?
Person: It's 45 euros, and all materials are included.
User: Great! Can I book a place for next month?

title: Reclamar una devolución de ropa defectuosa
description: Devolver un abrigo con defectos a una tienda de moda después de dos semanas de uso.
objective: Devuelve un abrigo azul marino comprado hace 14 días por €89,99: explica que la cremallera está rota, pide el reembolso completo en vez de un cambio y pregunta cuánto tarda (3-5 días hábiles).
scene_context: En el mostrador de servicio al cliente de una tienda de ropa en el centro comercial. El estudiante habla con el gerente de la tienda.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully explained product defect, negotiated refund instead of exchange, and received information about refund timeline.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon, how can I help you today?
User: Hi, I bought this navy blue coat here two weeks ago for €89.99, but the zipper is completely broken. I'd like a full refund rather than an exchange because I don't trust the quality.
Person: I understand your frustration. May I see the receipt and the coat? Unfortunately, our policy states we offer exchanges first, but if you'd prefer a refund, I could process that today.
User: Yes, I would really appreciate a refund. How long would it take to receive the money back to my card?
Person: Typically it takes between three and five business days once I process it. Would you like me to proceed with that?
User: Yes, please. Could you also explain why the zipper failed so quickly? I'm concerned about the overall durability of your products.
Person: That's a fair question. We'll look into this batch. Your refund will be processed immediately, and you should see it within five days maximum.

title: Posponer una entrevista de trabajo importante
description: Contactar a un reclutador para cambiar la fecha de una entrevista de trabajo que está programada en una fecha inconveniente.
objective: Llama al reclutador: tienes una cita médica ese día, pide posponer la entrevista dos semanas (del 15 al 29 de marzo), discúlpate y confirma que sigues interesado.
scene_context: El estudiante llama por teléfono a la oficina de recursos humanos de una empresa tecnológica. Habla con Paula, la reclutadora.
expected_outcome_indicator: Secured postponement of interview by two weeks while maintaining professional tone and expressing continued interest.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello, this is Paula from HR. I see you're calling about your interview appointment.
User: Hi Paula, yes, I'm calling because I need to reschedule my interview scheduled for March 15th. I have a medical appointment that was booked a month ago and I can't cancel it.
Person: I see. That's quite short notice. Can you tell me more about why you can't move your medical appointment instead?
User: Unfortunately, it's a specialist appointment that took weeks to get, so rescheduling would be very difficult. Could I possibly postpone the interview to March 29th instead?
Person: Let me check our calendar... Actually, March 29th works. However, I do need to ask: are you still genuinely interested in this position despite these complications?
User: Absolutely, I'm very interested. I apologize for the inconvenience, and I promise you won't regret reconsidering my application. Thank you so much for your flexibility.

title: Negociar el contrato de un Airbnb antes de reservar
description: Contactar al propietario de un Airbnb para discutir términos especiales antes de hacer la reserva oficial.
objective: Contacta al propietario para reservar del 10 al 17 de abril (7 noches), pide un 15% de descuento por estancia larga, pregunta la política de cancelación y negocia de €700 a €595.
scene_context: El estudiante envía un mensaje directo (chat) al propietario de un apartamento de dos dormitorios en el barrio de Gràcia en Barcelona.
expected_outcome_indicator: Negotiated a 15% discount for week-long stay and clarified inclusion of utilities and cancellation terms.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Thanks for your interest in my apartment. When are you planning to stay?
User: Hi! I'm interested in booking from April 10th to 17th—that's seven nights. I noticed your rate is €100 per night, so that would be €700 total. Since it's a longer stay, would you consider offering a discount, perhaps 15%?
Person: I appreciate the inquiry, but my prices are quite reasonable for the neighborhood. What if I offered 10% instead, bringing it to €630?
User: I understand, but I've seen similar places offering better rates for week-long bookings. Could we meet at 12% for around €615? Also, I'd like to confirm—does that price include WiFi, heating, and the initial cleaning?
Person: The WiFi and heating are included, yes. Initial cleaning is separate at €50. So with 12% discount plus cleaning, it would be €680 total. What about your cancellation policy requirements?
User: That works better. For cancellation, I'd prefer flexible cancellation up to five days before arrival. Is that possible with your terms?
Person: My standard policy is moderate, which allows cancellation up to 7 days before. I could adjust to 5 days for you given the longer stay. Shall I send you the official listing link to confirm the booking?

title: Argumentar la necesidad de trabajar desde casa
description: Proponer una nueva modalidad de trabajo flexible a tu jefe después de pasar seis meses en la empresa.
objective: Solicita teletrabajar lunes y miércoles: da tres razones (menos distracciones, mejor concentración, ahorras dos horas de transporte), ofrece un mes de prueba y propone reuniones presenciales martes y jueves.
scene_context: El estudiante tiene una reunión presencial en el despacho de su jefe, María, la directora del departamento de marketing en una empresa de tamaño medio.
expected_outcome_indicator: Presented structured proposal for remote work with clear benefits and willingness to trial the arrangement.
example_conversation:
Person: Come in, sit down. What did you want to discuss with me today?
User: Thank you for making time. I wanted to propose a flexible work arrangement. After six months here, I've noticed I'm most productive when I can concentrate deeply on big projects without office distractions. I'd like to work from home on Mondays and Wednesdays.
Person: Interesting idea, but our team usually collaborates daily. What specific benefits do you see for the company, not just for yourself?
User: Good question. I'd be more focused for detailed work, which means fewer errors and faster deliveries. I'd also save two hours commuting, which I could reinvest in my projects. I'm happy to come in Tuesday through Thursday for all meetings and collaborative work.
Person: That sounds reasonable, but I'm hesitant about the precedent this sets. What if other team members demand the same?
User: I completely understand your concern. What if we trial this for one month and measure my output and team communication? If it works well, we can discuss it with the team. If it doesn't, we revert to the current arrangement.
Person: That's a fair proposal. Let's try it for December and revisit in January. I'll need you to send me a detailed schedule showing your collaboration hours.

title: Cambiar el horario de una clase que ya pagaste
description: Contactas a tu centro de entrenamiento porque no puedes asistir a la clase que reservaste.
objective: Llamar al gimnasio para cambiar tu clase de pilates del jueves a las 18:30 (que ya pagaste 80 euros hace un mes) por otra clase disponible, explicar que tienes una reunión de trabajo ese día y preguntar si hay un costo adicional.
scene_context: Llamas por teléfono al centro de entrenamiento FitLife, hablas con un recepcionista.
expected_outcome_indicator: Rescheduled pilates class with work conflict explanation and confirmed no additional fee.
example_conversation:
Person: FitLife Gym, how can I assist you?
User: Hi, I need to reschedule my Thursday pilates class at 6:30 PM. I have an unexpected work meeting that day and can't attend.
Person: I understand. Let me check our schedule. Do you remember which instructor you had?
User: Yes, it was Maria's class. I paid 80 euros a month ago and I'd like to move it to another time. Is there an extra charge?
Person: No extra charge at all. Maria teaches Tuesday and Saturday mornings as well. Would either of those work for you?
User: Tuesday morning would be perfect. Could you confirm the new booking and let me know if I need to do anything else?

title: Reclamar un vuelo retrasado y pedir compensación
description: Tu vuelo se retrasó 4 horas y reclamas tus derechos de pasajero.
objective: Hablar con el representante de la aerolínea Blue Airways para reclamar compensación por un retraso de 4 horas en el vuelo BA 302 del 15 de marzo, mencionar que solicitaste comidas pero no las recibiste, y preguntar si eres elegible para los 250 euros de indemnización.
scene_context: Estás en el mostrador de atención al cliente del aeropuerto después de bajar del avión, hablas con un agente de Blue Airways.
expected_outcome_indicator: Registered flight delay complaint with meal refund and compensation eligibility explained.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon. I see you're here about a delayed flight. Can I have your booking reference?
User: Yes, it's BA 302 from March 15th. The flight was delayed four hours, and I requested meals during the wait but never received them. What compensation am I entitled to?
Person: I'm very sorry about that experience. According to EU regulations, you're eligible for 250 euros because the delay exceeded three hours. Did you purchase anything yourself?
User: Yes, I bought a sandwich and coffee for about 15 euros. Will that be refunded as well?
Person: Of course. I'll process both the compensation and your meal expenses. You should receive everything within two to three weeks to your bank account.
User: Thank you. Can you email me confirmation of this claim so I have it documented?

title: Reclamar sobre un electrodoméstico defectuoso
description: Devuelves un microondas roto a la tienda donde lo compraste hace dos semanas y negocias una solución.
objective: Explica que el microondas no calienta bien, que lo compraste hace 14 días por 89 euros, y negocia entre reparación gratuita o reembolso completo justificando tu elección.
scene_context: Estás en el mostrador de atención al cliente de una tienda de electrodomésticos. Hablas con el gerente de la tienda sobre tu compra defectuosa.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully negotiate repair or refund for faulty microwave bought 2 weeks ago for €89.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning, I see you'd like to speak to me about a microwave. What seems to be the problem?
User: Yes, I bought this microwave fourteen days ago for eighty-nine euros, but it doesn't heat food properly anymore. I've tried it several times and nothing works.
Person: I understand your frustration. Do you have the receipt with you? We could either repair it free of charge or process a refund, though that might take up to two weeks.
User: I have the receipt here. Honestly, I'd prefer a refund because I need a working microwave right now for my daily cooking. Would that be possible?
Person: Since you're within our two-week return window, I can absolutely arrange that for you. Can I have your name and contact details?
User: Of course. It's Elena Martínez, and my email is elena.martinez@email.com. When would the refund appear in my bank account?
Person: It should process within five to seven business days. I'll email you a confirmation receipt today.

title: Reclamar un reembolso parcial por un viaje pospuesto
description: Debe contactar a una agencia de viajes para recuperar dinero por un viaje que tuvo que postponer por razones personales.
objective: Lograr un reembolso de al menos 200 euros de los 850 euros pagados por un viaje a Barcelona del 15 de julio que pospuso para el 20 de septiembre. Debe explicar las razones, preguntar sobre la política de cancelación y negociar las condiciones.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina de una agencia de viajes llamada 'Viajes Express'. Hablas con María, la agente de viajes que organizó tu reserva original.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student negotiates partial refund for postponed trip and clarifies cancellation policy.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! I'm here about my Barcelona trip booking. How can I help you today?
User: Hello Maria. I booked a trip for July 15th for 850 euros, but I need to postpone it until September 20th due to personal reasons. Is it possible to get a refund?
Person: I understand. Let me check the cancellation policy. Since you're postponing rather than cancelling completely, we typically charge a 30% administration fee. That would be about 255 euros in fees.
User: That seems quite high. I'm still travelling with you, just at a different date. Could you consider a lower fee, maybe 15%? What if I book additional services?
Person: I appreciate your loyalty. A 15% fee would be 127 euros, leaving you with a credit of 723 euros. However, the September date has different pricing, so you may need to pay a small difference.
User: That sounds more reasonable. Can you check if the September dates are available and tell me what the price difference would be? Also, can I get a written confirmation of this agreement?

title: Reclamar sobre un mal servicio de limpieza del hogar
description: Necesitas contactar a la empresa de limpieza para reclamar sobre el trabajo deficiente realizado la semana pasada.
objective: Explica qué salió mal en la limpieza (3-4 áreas: cocina, baños, alfombras), por qué no estás satisfecho, pregunta si pueden volver sin coste adicional y acuerda una fecha entre el 15 y el 20 de marzo.
scene_context: Estás llamando por teléfono a la oficina de la empresa de limpieza. Hablas con el gerente de servicio al cliente.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully complains about service quality, provides specific details, and negotiates a free revisit.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon, thank you for calling CleanHome Services. How can I help you today?
User: Hello, I'm calling because I'm really disappointed with the cleaning service you provided at my house last week. The kitchen wasn't thoroughly cleaned and the bathrooms still had stains.
Person: I'm very sorry to hear that. Could you tell me more about what exactly didn't meet your expectations? We pride ourselves on our quality standards.
User: Well, the tiles in both bathrooms weren't properly scrubbed, the kitchen appliances were left streaky, and the carpets looked like they hadn't been vacuumed properly. I've been a customer for two years and this is the worst job they've done.
Person: That's concerning. I sincerely apologize. Would you be willing to let us send a team to redo the cleaning at no additional charge?
User: Yes, that would be great. Could we schedule it between March 15th and 20th? Would morning or afternoon be better for you?
Person: We can definitely arrange that. How about March 18th in the morning, around 9 AM?
User: That works perfectly. Thank you for resolving this so quickly.
